description:
Design a microfluidic mixing chip in LibreCAD. 

1. Set units to Millimeters.
2. Create a 'SUBSTRATE' layer (White/Black) and draw a 75mm x 25mm rectangle (standard slide) with bottom-left at (0,0).
3. Create a 'RESERVOIRS' layer (Cyan) and draw two circles with diameter 4mm (radius 2mm) centered at (10, 12.5) and (65, 12.5).
4. Create a 'CHANNEL' layer (Green). Draw a zig-zag path connecting the inlet (10, 12.5) to the outlet (65, 12.5). The path should zigzag up to y=21 and down to y=4 multiple times across the length.
5. CRITICAL: Use the Fillet tool (Modify > Fillet) with Radius 3.0 to round all sharp corners of the zig-zag path on the CHANNEL layer.
6. Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/microfluidic_chip.dxf'.
